pr_body:
Closes #62

## Summary

Adds a manual-only workflow that runs the closest available public-data reconstruction of the AGENTICAITA paper window.

## Changes

- Adds a `Paper Window Real Data Replication` workflow with manual dispatch inputs.
- Uses the fixed paper window, one-minute candles, and 15-symbol baseline subset.
- Attempts Hyperliquid first in `closest` mode and falls back to Binance USD-M when Hyperliquid cannot produce complete exportable OHLCV coverage.
- Runs real-data replication, quality checks, run manifests, result index, HTML dashboard, Actions summary, and compact artefact upload.
- Avoids raw SQLite and raw per-symbol OHLCV uploads by default.
- Documents the workflow and interpretation limits.

## Validation

- `git apply --check /mnt/data/issue62.patch` in a clean temporary git repository.
- Static review of workflow steps against existing scripts.
- Full live market-data workflow was not run from this patch submission because it is manual and may take a long time or hit public exchange rate limits.
